name: Hermes Agent

version_poll.transform: date tag vYYYY.M.D(.N) from tag_name; semver app version from the release title, e.g. 'Hermes Agent v0.21.2 (v2026.9.11)'; display 'vX.Y.Z (YYYY.M.D)'; use the semver for the changelog id

cross_check: release title vs tag; NEVER use PyPI hermes-agent (lags badly)
release_notes: Narrative essays covering hundreds of commits — summarize, extracting ONLY items touching the scope_allowlist surface; ignore everything else.
gotchas: General-purpose agent — placemat covers the CLI/TUI coding surface ONLY (scope_allowlist); never add anything on the scope_denylist
The docs site 404s on .md — ALWAYS fetch markdown from raw_mirror instead
Dual versioning: date tag + semver title; tag date can differ from publish date; same-day .N patch tags
llms-full.txt is ~3.7 MB — never ingest whole; use /docs/llms.txt to detect page churn
Docs pages rename frequently — re-derive paths from llms.txt when a fetch 404s
The scope note beside the legend must stay generic: naming excluded features in index.html would defeat the denylist grep that guards the scope
